comment: The personal-health-record example assumes that individuals can interact digitally with their records. It does not visibly address people without smartphones, digital identity, connectivity, literacy, legal documentation, or capacity to manage consent independently.

public.text: The personal-health-record example assumes that individuals can interact digitally with their records. It does not visibly address people without smartphones, digital identity, connectivity, literacy, legal documentation, or capacity to manage consent independently.
public.suggestedRevision: Add assisted and non-digital access pathways, delegated access, accessibility requirements, caregiver arrangements, child and guardian access, and mechanisms for people without foundational identity or personal devices.
